newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African money shortage falls to 10.312 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African money shortage falls to 10.312 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's money market shortage fell to 10.312 billion rand on Thursday from 10.904 billion on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank said on Friday.
Wednesday's shortage was the highest since the record 10.955 billion recorded on April 30 this year.
Major banks on Friday quoted three-month NCD rates unchanged at between 17.40 and 17.75 percent while the 90-day BA rate was also steady at 16.70 to 17.00 percent.
